_instructions.how_to_add_an_HD_graphic: Export your PowerPoint/Canva slide as a PNG or JPG (File > Export > Image, highest quality). Drop the file into /assets/data-division/. Then copy an 'image' block below, set 'image' to that file's path, fill in title/description/sector, save. It appears in the gallery and opens full-size when clicked.
_instructions.how_to_add_a_dashboard: If it's Power BI: in Power BI, choose File > Embed report > Publish to web (or use your organisation's secure embed link), copy the embed URL. Paste it into 'embedUrl' on a 'dashboard' block below. Works the same for Tableau Public, Looker Studio, or any tool that gives you an embeddable link.
_instructions.how_to_add_an_interactive_chart_without_: Copy a 'chart' block, change 'chartType' to bar / line / pie / doughnut, replace 'labels' with your categories and 'series' with your numbers. No image needed — it draws itself.
_instructions.how_to_add_an_article: Copy an 'article' block, fill in title/excerpt/sector, and set 'link' to a page on this site (e.g. an Updates post) or an external report URL.
_instructions.how_to_choose_a_chart_type: Pick the chart by what you want to say. bar: simple vertical comparisons across a few categories. horizontalBar: ranked comparisons and long category names (labels wrap, never rotate). groupedBar: compare several series side by side per category. stackedBar: parts of a whole per category, stacked vertically. stackedBar100: share of a whole per category (raw numbers in JSON, chart shows %). line: change over time; area: change over time with the volume filled in. steppedLine: values that jump between levels rather than gliding. radar: compare a few items across several indicators at once. pie / doughnut / polarArea: shares of one whole (doughnut has the hole). scatter: two measures plotted as x/y points. bubble: three measures at once (x, y and bubble size). combo: a count as bars plus a rate as a line on a second axis. Add "sortDescending": true to bar/horizontalBar to rank biggest first.
_instructions.chart_block_examples: One tiny valid example per chartType, as strings (not real items). Every chart needs: "type": "chart", "chartType", "labels" (except scatter/bubble), "series": [{"name": ..., "data": [...]}]. Data lengths must match labels. Optional on any chart: "unit" (e.g. "%", "USD"), "xAxisTitle", "yAxisTitle". Optional per series: "color" (hex override). Combo series also take "type": "bar"|"line" and "axis": "left"|"right" (plus "rightAxisTitle"). bar/horizontalBar also take "sortDescending": true. Scatter/bubble series data are {"x": n, "y": n} (bubble adds "r": n). EXAMPLES (strings only): {"type":"chart","chartType":"bar","labels":["A","B"],"series":[{"name":"Share","data":[30,70]}]} | {"type":"chart","chartType":"horizontalBar","sortDescending":true,"labels":["Long category name here"],"series":[{"name":"Share","data":[42]}]} | {"type":"chart","chartType":"groupedBar","labels":["2023","2024"],"series":[{"name":"Urban","data":[40,55]},{"name":"Rural","data":[30,45]}]} | {"type":"chart","chartType":"stackedBar","labels":["2023","2024"],"series":[{"name":"Urban","data":[40,55]},{"name":"Rural","data":[30,45]}]} | {"type":"chart","chartType":"stackedBar100","unit":"%","labels":["2023","2024"],"series":[{"name":"Urban","data":[40,55]},{"name":"Rural","data":[60,45]}]} | {"type":"chart","chartType":"line","xAxisTitle":"Year","labels":["2021","2022","2023"],"series":[{"name":"Index","data":[12,19,15]}]} | {"type":"chart","chartType":"area","labels":["2021","2022","2023"],"series":[{"name":"Index","data":[12,19,15]}]} | {"type":"chart","chartType":"steppedLine","labels":["2021","2022","2023"],"series":[{"name":"Level","data":[1,1,2]}]} | {"type":"chart","chartType":"radar","labels":["Reach","Quality","Speed"],"series":[{"name":"2023","data":[4,3,5]},{"name":"2024","data":[5,4,4]}]} | {"type":"chart","chartType":"pie","labels":["A","B"],"series":[{"name":"Share","data":[30,70]}]} | {"type":"chart","chartType":"doughnut","labels":["A","B"],"series":[{"name":"Share","data":[30,70]}]} | {"type":"chart","chartType":"polarArea","labels":["A","B","C"],"series":[{"name":"Share","data":[30,50,20]}]} | {"type":"chart","chartType":"scatter","xAxisTitle":"Cost","yAxisTitle":"Return","series":[{"name":"Projects","data":[{"x":10,"y":20},{"x":15,"y":25}]}]} | {"type":"chart","chartType":"bubble","series":[{"name":"Projects","data":[{"x":10,"y":20,"r":15},{"x":30,"y":40,"r":45}]}]} | {"type":"chart","chartType":"combo","rightAxisTitle":"Rate %","labels":["Q1","Q2"],"series":[{"name":"Count","type":"bar","data":[120,150]},{"name":"Rate","type":"line","axis":"right","data":[62,71]}]}
_instructions.card_fields_updated_and_labels: Every item needs an "updated" month ("YYYY-MM", e.g. "2026-09"), shown on its card as "Updated: Sep, 2026". Set it to the month the underlying visual or data was last refreshed. Card corner badges are automatic, not typed in: embeds and anything explorable (Tableau, Power BI, custom HTML, maps, timelines, dashboards) show "Interactive"; images, site-drawn charts and plain datasets show "Static".
